# Synthetic vision fixtures

These JPEGs are deterministic, artificial text labels generated by
`python -m scripts.make_vision_fixtures` from the backend directory. They are not
photographs of real motors and do not establish recognition accuracy on hardware.

- `synthetic_nameplate_a.jpg`: 230 V, 4.2 A, DEMO-123, 0.75 kW, 50 Hz.
- `synthetic_nameplate_b.jpg`: 400 V, 2.4 A, same other fields.

The adjacent JSON files contain ground truth. Use A then B to verify context reset
and two device IDs to verify separation. Use your own clear, consented equipment
photos for V03–V10. Do not present synthetic-fixture results as real nameplate OCR
accuracy, electrical measurements, fault diagnosis or certification.
